source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
The Best Team is usually the only team still undefeated when the event ends. When that doesn't settle it, or teams want their placings, rank teams with the same record by:

1. Record (wins, losses and draws).
2. Total individual wins of all team members across all rounds.
3. Total Battle Points (BP) of all team members across all rounds.

rankingOrder: team record of wins, losses and draws
total Battle Points from all members across rounds
